svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, Bash. Backend: Django, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, Express, Celery. Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, MongoDB. Cloud & ops: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Linux, Nginx, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions. Frontend: React, Next.js, Astro, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Figma. AI & ML: LangChain, LangGraph, Gemini, TensorFlow, scikit-learn. Daily tools: Git, Postman, pnpm, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
